The blur is likely intentional depth-of-field, but the edge transition on the thumb shows slight smearing into the lighter body, suggesting a minor grounding issue (severity 1.0 is appropriate). The Perceptual Quality Auditor found no graphics-level distortions, which supports that the issues are structural/semantic rather than compression/noise related.
